appearance_facts.fact: The pale yellow wedge is the widest slice on the page, spanning roughly 162 degrees from the top vertical edge to the mid-left boundary.
The orange wedge is the second-largest visible area, occupying the entire right side from the top vertical edge to the lower-right boundary.
The dark red wedge is the third-largest visible area, situated between the pale yellow and orange-tan wedges on the left side.
The orange-tan wedge is the smallest visible area, located at the bottom of the circle.

printed_facts.fact: The title reads 'Global Energy Consumption by Source'.

public_definitions: The routing criterion is defined as the 'Largest global energy consumption category'.
uncertain: There is a visual discrepancy between the apparent size of the wedges and their printed percentage labels; the pale yellow wedge (labeled 45%) is the largest area, while the orange wedge (labeled 10%) is the second largest area.
